title: Limitless X Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Limitless X Holdings Inc., a Delaware micro-cap company, filed an 8-K disclosing a settlement agreement with CEO Jaspreet Mathur regarding $50,000 in previously promised compensation. The company agreed to issue 550,000 shares of Class B Convertible Preferred Stock in lieu of cash bonuses and incentives tied to milestone achievements including acquiring celebrity contracts.
key_points: MOU dated April 8, 2026 settles all bonus and incentive stock compensation promised to CEO Jaspreet Mathur under his employment offer letter
Company to issue 550,000 shares of Class B Convertible Preferred Stock as full compensation for outstanding bonuses
Class B Preferred Stock carries no voting rights, no accrued dividends, and a $3.00 per share liquidation preference
Each Class B share converts to 0.067 shares of common stock, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap (expandable to 9.99%)
The filing was signed by CEO Jaspreet Mathur on April 9, 2026
The company is a micro-cap registrant (CIK 0001803977) with no securities listed on major exchanges
